season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep with October marginal. Logged ascents of the peak: Jun 74, Jul 61, Aug 66, Sep 68, Oct 44, May 26. Web: Mountaineers route page warns the approach gets icy late in the season; guidebook-style pages give July-October as prime for the Stuart Range peaks and snow gear needed in spring. Keep Jul-Sep; June and early October usable with axe and traction.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Aug 20 2026 summit; starts exactly at our 'leave the trail' pin between Leprechaun and Sprite Lakes, so it is a segment of our line only, 9.7 km from the trailhead pin, not a trailhead track. Report names the Prong scree, harder west finish and easy east descent, consistent with our route.

facts.text: Late June can still hold a short steep snow patch near 7,900 ft on the approach and snow on the north side of the ridge crossing; carry an axe, and crampons or microspikes for the descent slope.
The steep sand-and-scree slope beside the Prong is the trickiest ground in August; hugging the rock ribs on either side gives better footing than the loose middle.

notes: Only one route on this peak. Every harvested in-season track starts at another trailhead or mid-route; none starts at Snow Lakes Trailhead, so no track assigned. 3328028 (Aug 2026) could serve as a junction-to-summit segment if the owner wants partial tracks. Distance and gain figures were not recorded for it.
